paragraphs.source_en: Nobumoto gained a newfound respect for Hirate Nakatsukasa. Though Oda Nobuhide came from a collateral branch, he had risen above the main house and established dominion over the region precisely because he had strategists like this at his side. Nobuhide had appointed this man as Kippōshi’s tutor and entrusted him with the boy’s discipline. Nobuhide’s fierce courage, Nakatsukasa’s cunning, and Kippōshi, who had never shown the slightest regard for anyone—all of it weighed upon Nobumoto like an enormous invisible stone.
